---
name: How it went
about: You made a film with this skill, or you got stuck. Either helps.
labels: feedback
---

**What you asked for.** The request you gave your agent, and which agent it was.

**What came out.** A link if you can share it, or a sentence if you can't. Was it worth keeping?

**Where it stopped or fell short.** The step where you gave up, or what you had to fix yourself. "It just looked
generic" is useful.

Please leave out private footage, client material and personal data.
